readings.commitment: The Press Clause's oldest rule is its strongest: prior restraint comes with a heavy presumption against it, and even the Pentagon Papers could not overcome it
readings.delta: Suppression of pre-publication control near-absolutely; beneficiary is publishers racing the injunction; victim set is secrecy-by-restraint strategies; extractiveness of suppression shifted to after-the-fact remedies

readings.commitment: Branzburg left the privilege unsettled: no constitutional shield for sources before grand juries, yet a concurrence and forty-nine state laws built one anyway — the clause's institutional promise half-kept
readings.delta: Suppression of source confidentiality at the federal constitutional level; beneficiary is grand-jury process; victim set is confidential-source journalism; extractiveness of testimony available against the newsroom

readings.commitment: The Press Clause protects the technology, not a guild: every user of the means of publication holds it, bloggers as fully as broadsheets — the institutional reading rejected
readings.delta: Suppression of press-card gatekeeping; beneficiary is every publisher down to one; victim set is institutional-privilege claims; extractiveness of special status denied and the right universalized

readings.commitment: Assembly matured into association: the right to organize, join, and exclude for expressive ends — NAACP membership lists protected and parade organizers choosing their message
readings.delta: Suppression of forced disclosure and forced inclusion; beneficiary is organizations' expressive integrity; victim set is compelled-membership and compelled-transparency regimes; extractiveness of association's content from the state's reach

readings.commitment: Assembly meets the permit office: licensing of marches constitutional only with definite standards, no official discretion, and no fee scaled to hostile reaction
readings.delta: Suppression of discretionary gatekeeping of the streets; beneficiary is unpopular marchers; victim set is administrative veto by delay or fee; extractiveness of assembly priced by content forbidden

readings.commitment: Petition is the forgotten clause: older than speech, the right to demand answer from government — its modern life submerged in speech doctrine, its separate force a standing question
readings.delta: Suppression of the clause by doctrinal merger; beneficiary is unified speech analysis; victim set is petition's distinct guarantees (response, access); extractiveness of the demand-right unmeasured because unlitigated

readings.commitment: The Third Amendment lives in the penumbras: cited in Griswold as evidence the Constitution builds a zone around the home — its work done by implication, not application
readings.delta: Suppression of the home's openness to state presence generalized; beneficiary is privacy doctrine's structure; victim set is narrow-clause literalism; extractiveness of domestic intrusion disfavored across doctrines

readings.commitment: The Amendment marks the deep rule: military power subordinate to civil society, the army kept out of the household as synecdoche for keeping it out of governance
readings.delta: Suppression of military presence in civilian life; beneficiary is civil supremacy doctrine; victim set is militarized administration; extractiveness of garrison government forbidden at the threshold

readings.commitment: The least-litigated amendment is the most successful: no quartering happened, so no cases did — dormancy as the measure of a prohibition that fully worked
readings.delta: Suppression so complete the docket is empty; beneficiary is householders who never noticed; victim set is none remaining; extractiveness of the practice extinct, the clause its tombstone

readings.commitment: Gideon made counsel the gateway right: a lawyer for every felony defendant, appointed if necessary — the guarantee that operationalizes all the others
readings.delta: Suppression of lawyerless prosecution; beneficiary is indigent defendants; victim set is conviction-by-default economics; extractiveness of process unnavigable alone remedied by appointment

readings.commitment: Crawford restored confrontation's edge: testimonial statements require the witness, cross-examination the only constitutional test of reliability — the clause un-balanced back to its text
readings.delta: Suppression of hearsay shortcuts in testimonial form; beneficiary is the cross-examining accused; victim set is absent-witness prosecution; extractiveness of conviction on untested statements barred

readings.commitment: The jury must be drawn from the community whole: fair cross-section in the venire, no exclusion by race or sex in selection — the jury's legitimacy resting on whom it could contain
readings.delta: Suppression of engineered jury pools; beneficiary is defendants judged by the actual community; victim set is exclusionary selection systems; extractiveness of verdicts from unrepresentative panels delegitimated

readings.commitment: The civil jury is measured against 1791: suits at common law then get juries now, equity and admiralty do not — a doctrine that sends modern claims to an eighteenth-century sorting hat
readings.delta: Suppression of jury claims outside the historical line; beneficiary is the fixed historical method; victim set is novel claims awkwardly analogized; extractiveness of the jury right rationed by antiquarian mapping

readings.commitment: The unresolved question is complexity: whether litigation can be too intricate for lay jurors — the exception argued, never blessed, and quietly practiced through summary judgment
readings.delta: Suppression of the jury by procedural substitutes where complexity daunts; beneficiary is bench and expert resolution; victim set is the jury's domain at the margin; extractiveness of fact-finding migrating to judges without a holding

readings.commitment: The Amendment's second sentence guards verdicts: no fact tried by jury reexamined except by common-law rules — the verdict protected from appellate second-guessing as much as the trial from denial
readings.delta: Suppression of appellate fact re-trial; beneficiary is verdict finality; victim set is reviewing courts' reach into facts; extractiveness of the jury's product armored after delivery

readings.commitment: The Ninth is a reservoir: unenumerated rights retained by the people are real rights, and Goldberg's Griswold concurrence read the clause as their textual spring
readings.delta: Suppression of enumeration-exhaustion arguments with affirmative force; beneficiary is unenumerated-rights jurisprudence; victim set is list-closing interpretation; extractiveness of liberty's residue judicially cognizable

readings.commitment: The Ninth is a rule about reading, not a fount of rights: it forbids one inference — that enumeration denies others — and grants nothing itself
readings.delta: Suppression of a single interpretive move only; beneficiary is constructional modesty; victim set is reservoir readings; extractiveness of new rights not derivable from the clause alone

readings.commitment: Courts have left the Ninth unused: no holding rests on it alone — a clause whose open texture gives judges nothing to apply and everything to fear
readings.delta: Suppression of the clause by judicial abstention; beneficiary is doctrinal predictability; victim set is the clause's potential claimants; extractiveness of its protections unrealized for want of a method

readings.commitment: The Tenth's modern teeth are anticommandeering: Congress may not conscript state legislatures or officers to administer federal programs — New York and Printz drew the line
readings.delta: Suppression of federal conscription of state machinery; beneficiary is state administrative autonomy; victim set is federal programs needing state hands; extractiveness of implementation purchasable but not commandable

readings.commitment: Darby called it a truism: the Tenth states what the structure already implies — undelegated power stays reserved — adding emphasis and nothing else
readings.delta: Suppression of independent Tenth Amendment doctrine; beneficiary is broad federal-power readings; victim set is states'-rights litigation strategies; extractiveness of federal reach limited only by enumeration itself

readings.commitment: Federalism's real protection is political: states defend themselves through the Senate and the parties, and courts should leave the boundary to that process
readings.delta: Suppression of judicial federalism policing; beneficiary is the political process and federal majorities; victim set is judicially-enforced state spheres; extractiveness of the balance left to elections

readings.commitment: What counts as compelling is the tier's hidden ledger: remedying identified discrimination yes, diversity for a time, administrative convenience never — the interests list is the doctrine
readings.delta: Suppression keyed to a short approved list; beneficiary is interests that made the list; victim set is classifications serving anything else; extractiveness of racial sorting permitted only for enumerated ends

readings.commitment: Tailoring does the operational work: race-neutral alternatives must be exhausted, the fit tight, the duration limited — most programs die here, not at the interest stage
readings.delta: Suppression executed at the means inquiry; beneficiary is challengers attacking fit; victim set is blunt remedial designs; extractiveness of the classification permitted only at minimum dose

readings.commitment: Strict in theory, fatal in fact, then fatal again: after the affirmative-action era's interval, SFFA closed it — the tier's history is the gradual completion of Gunther's quip
readings.delta: Suppression converging on categorical; beneficiary is colorblind-rule advocates; victim set is race-conscious remediation; extractiveness of any racial line nearly unsurvivable

readings.commitment: VMI raised the middle tier: an exceedingly persuasive justification required, no reliance on overbroad generalizations about the sexes — intermediate scrutiny with a strict accent
readings.delta: Suppression of stereotype-based justification; beneficiary is sex-equality claimants post-1996; victim set is tradition-based single-sex arrangements; extractiveness of sex lines requiring near-compelling defense

readings.commitment: The tier's escape valve is real differences: where the sexes are not similarly situated, classification may follow biology — the doctrine's most contested boundary
readings.delta: Suppression relaxed where difference is credited as real; beneficiary is biology-based legislative lines; victim set is claimants against credited differences; extractiveness of sex classification surviving where difference persuades

readings.commitment: The middle tier drifts: applied to sex, illegitimacy, sometimes more, with rigor varying by era and bench — intermediate scrutiny as the doctrine that proves the tiers are a dial, not boxes
readings.delta: Suppression calibrated case by case in practice; beneficiary is judicial flexibility; victim set is tier-formalism's predictability; extractiveness of classification judged on a sliding scale wearing three labels

readings.commitment: Rational basis is deference nearly complete: any conceivable legitimate purpose suffices, hypothesized after the fact — Lee Optical's standard, under which almost nothing falls
readings.delta: Suppression nearly nil (the tier exists to uphold); beneficiary is legislative line-drawing freedom; victim set is economic-liberty challengers; extractiveness of ordinary regulation unreviewed in substance

readings.commitment: Sometimes the tier bites: Moreno, Cleburne, Romer — when bare desire to harm a group is the only explanation, rational basis finds irrationality without changing tiers
readings.delta: Suppression activated against animus; beneficiary is targeted unpopular groups below suspect status; victim set is hostility-driven classification; extractiveness of harm-for-its-own-sake failing even the lowest bar

readings.commitment: Olech opened equality to a class of one: arbitrary singling-out of a single person states a claim — equal protection as a guarantee against vendetta, not just against caste
readings.delta: Suppression of individualized arbitrary treatment; beneficiary is the singled-out property owner or applicant; victim set is unexplained administrative differentiation; extractiveness of spite actionable one citizen at a time
